request: Reduce visual vibration while walking, running and jumping
basis: Authored avatar and latest exploration camera presentation only; original city, physical capsule, speed and jump controls retained

avatar.torso: Fixed local position (0,0.85,0) and zero lateral roll during locomotion; keep smoothly blended forward lean
avatar.removed: Former abs(sin(2*phase)) vertical pulses: up to8.8Hz in turbo gait,5.8Hz on treadmill
avatar.feet: Cosine fore-aft path and sine-squared swing lift with continuous turnarounds; same stance height, IK reach and cadence cap
avatar.scope: Procedural game gait, not motion capture; limb movement remains

camera.contract: Physics owns player collision and obstruction-tested camera endpoints; stable presentation must preserve collision-safe paths, immediate blocked-path snaps and explicit portal/relocation resets
camera.presentation: One drawable-only RenderProxy under ExplorationAvatar; camera and visible avatar root use the same previous/current physics endpoints and render fraction
camera.ownership: Player, Visual and ExplorationAvatar roots, capsule and local limb joints remain physics-owned. Proxy restores identity before movement/facility/animation physics; no project-wide interpolation change.
camera.snaps: Collision-blocked transitions, explicit relocation and recovery collapse both camera and visible root histories; pause keeps last displayed pose.

limits: No performance or human comfort acceptance from automated fixture checks.
Existing historical scenes and source-world dimensions retained.
